hero.description: AI-powered weekly plans, full workout tracking, strength rankings and a community that keeps you motivated. The fitness app that adapts to you.

features.subtitle: Features designed so you can focus on what matters: your training.

aiPlans.title: AI Weekly Plans
aiPlans.description: Generate a personalized weekly plan based on your goal, level, available days and equipment — powered by AI.

library.title: 1500+ Exercises
library.description: A full exercise library with visual guides, filterable by muscle group and equipment. Use ready-made routines or build your own and organize them in folders.

tracking.title: Workout Tracking
tracking.description: Log sets, reps and weight with a built-in rest timer. Works offline and syncs automatically when you're back online.

progress.title: Progress & Stats
progress.description: Charts, personal records, streaks, monthly reports and a muscle heatmap so you can see exactly how you're improving.

rankings.title: Strength Rankings
rankings.description: Earn your Repp Rank and climb the tiers. Compare your strength by muscle group, adjusted to your body weight.

community.title: Community
community.description: Share your workouts, follow your friends and stay motivated with likes and comments on every session.

cta.description: Download the app and take your training to the next level. Free to start.
